description: Read-only Google Business Profile listing profile for the project's linked location: title, categories, phone, website, description, hours-period count, and which of Google's attribute taxonomy entries are set. Fetched LIVE from Google on every call. Returns NOT_FOUND if no location is linked yet — link one with set_gbp_connection (list_gbp_locations has the ids).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_gbp_profile
